service.text: IOService class/name HakiosGPU; kIOUserClientClassKey value HakiosGPUUserClient; IOServiceMatching("HakiosGPU"), IOServiceOpen type 0. No chip/family/capability properties are published by these four files. kIOUserClientClassKey string definition is outside scope.

readiness.text: User client start requires hakios_gpu_ready(). Methods return NotReady after ready is lost, except SHOW; first reject null input, input >72 bytes, or missing fBuffers.

framing.text: Selectors are request numbers, not Linux ioctl encoded words. Native little-endian 64-bit records; pointers are uint64 user virtual addresses, never portable file offsets. Kernel zero-fills union then copies 0..72 input bytes, with no per-selector exact-size check; successful output copies min(input size, output capacity), including padding. Metal passes same in/out pointer and length but does not validate returned length. This checker requires canonical full sizes; it is intentionally stricter.

params.text: MsmParam pipe=1 from Metal; kernel only consumes param/value and delegates to external hakios_gpu_parameter, so actual supported IDs/values cannot be established here. gpu.hpp lists IDs 1..10,0x10..0x13; its comment says GPU_ID value 0 on its upstream target, not selector 0. chipId() truncates uint64 to low uint32; faults() and chipId() return 0 on query failure. A635-family 0x06030500 in comments is not A530 device evidence.

gem_new.text: Metal rejects size 0, rounds to 16 KiB, creates -> queries IOVA -> maps; info/map failure closes handle (map failure ENOMEM). Kernel rounds with round_page_64/PAGE_SIZE (numeric kernel PAGE_SIZE definition outside these files), accepts rounded 1..256 MiB, allocates handle 1..8192 and maps GPU pages in 4096-byte steps; GPU_READONLY bit passed to backend. Fresh memory is zeroed per source comment; kept same-client size/flags buffers can be returned uncleared unless gpu_keep=2. Flags do not select WC in gemNew.

gem_info.text: Invalid handle BadArgument; info0 OFFSET=handle<<32 (not mapped by this offset); info1 IOVA=GPU address; info5 FLAGS=saved flags; info2 SET_NAME success/no storage; others Unsupported. len/pad not consumed by this implementation.

cpu_prep_fini.text: PREP ignores handle and waits for global hakios_gpu_last(), not BO-local fence. op&4 NOSYNC gives patience0; otherwise absolute continuous-clock deadline, clamped 0..5000ms with overflow handling. Poll delay 200us. Unfinished PREP returns Busy. FINI is success/no-op; Metal ignores its error.

submit.text: nr_bos 1..8192, nr_cmds 1..128; copyin arrays of 16/32-byte records (VMError on copy failure). Non-type1 commands skipped. Type1 requires live command BO index, nr_relocs=0, offset/size divisible by4, uint64(offset)+size <= BO bytes. Zero command size and all-skipped types are not explicitly rejected. BO presumed/flags and request pipe/queue/syncobj fields are not used for scheduling or relocation here; invalid non-command BOs are skipped in cache/fence loops. Calls EXTERNAL hakios_gpu_submit(addresses,words,count); nonzero fence Success, zero Timeout. FENCE_FD_OUT sets fence_fd=-1, no fd exported.

metal_submit.text: Metal rejects zero words, misaligned offset or out-of-BO end; command BO first/READ; other uses deduplicated by handle and READ/WRITE ORed. One CMD_BUF, byte size words*4, flags=pipe3D, fence_fd=-1, queueid supplied; bos/cmds are temporary uint64 process VAs valid for synchronous call. Fence output changes only on success. words*4 is uint32 in cmd.size; caller/newBo size constraints matter.

wait_fence.text: WAIT rejects signed-wrap comparison (int32)(fence-last)>0, otherwise waits requested fence to absolute continuous deadline (max5000ms); unfinished Timeout. flags and queueid ignored. Metal clamps negative duration to0 and adds nowNs; signed addition overflow is not handled in deadline().

queues_close.text: QUEUE_NEW returns ++fNextQueue; flags/prio unused, no demonstrated independent queues. QUEUE_CLOSE, SET_PARAM, CPU_FINI success/no-op. QUERY attempts copyout uint64 zero if data!=0 && len>=8, ignoring copyout return and query id/param. MADVISE retained=1. GEM_CLOSE invalid handle BadArgument, otherwise removes handle and defers busy memory reclamation, may retain memory indefinitely after hang. Metal unmaps then closes on owned BO release; disown unmaps without closing duplicate handle.

surface_user_show.text: SURFACE ID -> cached IOSurface memory, metadata/40-byte record, same live handle on repeat; handle=0xffffffff describes only and returns handle0. NotFound absent, Unsupported client-backed surface. USER_MEMORY address/size whole kernel pages, nonzero<=256MiB; prepares/wires pages, readonly fallback sets GPU_READONLY=0x2, VMError if neither prepare works. SHOW is CPU pixel copy to panel, not GPU submit: 32-bit blue-first, width/height1..4096, rowBytes>=4*width, total<=256MiB.

mapping_cache.text: Map memory type=GEM handle; clientMemoryForType retains memory, marks seen=true, options=0. Metal IOConnectMapMemory64 uses kIOMapAnywhere, ignores supplied expected size and returned map size; map error nullptr, unmap result ignored. GEM allocations default descriptor WC, gpu_cached=1 ordinary cached; kBoWriteCombined numeric flag is declared but not consulted to choose cache mode. Submit flushes mapped cached GEMs, imported user pages by physical segments every submission, surfaces unless unchanged seed/unseen/<4ms; mapped surfaces every submission. Always calls to_memory(NULL,0) barrier. CPU_PREP waits; FINI performs no cache maintenance. to_memory/flush implementations outside scope, so no proven A530 coherency or invalidation guarantee.

returns.text: IOKit symbolic Success->0, NoMemory->ENOMEM, BadArgument->EINVAL, Timeout->ETIMEDOUT, Busy->EBUSY, NotFound->ENOENT, Unsupported->ENOSYS; all others (including NotReady/VMError) log and EIO. Surface API comment says ENOTSUP but actual transport returns ENOSYS. Actual numeric IOReturn definitions are outside permitted four sources; test shim numbers are surrogate tokens, not ABI evidence. Host errno numbers must not be serialized as Darwin errno numbers.

limitations: No A530 register, power, firmware, SMMU, command-stream, fence completion or cache hardware validation.
No backend implementation read: external declarations/call sites establish dependency, not A530 support.
Host execute()/a530_submit() returns unsupported for valid shapes and never issues or fabricates a fence.
HakiosMetalCA caller and Metal capability implementation are outside four-file scope; no end-to-end compatibility claim.
No runtime service discovery, device access, upstream edits, build/index/AGENTS changes or shared file writes.
Native arm64 layout compile is host cross-compilation; it is not an arm64 execution or hardware test.
